About this role

Individual Giving has set an objective to double new donor acquisition in 2027 and expand our awareness through brand ads for key segments. Paid media is the biggest lever we have to get there, and as Growth Manager, Paid Media, you'll own delivery of this important priority. To help get us there, GiveDirectly is planning to expand its spend on paid media.

We are looking for someone who will be a strong cultural fit—curious, keen not to follow industry standards but to look for disproportionately high-leverage opportunities, keen to constantly learn and adjust, and comfortable launching a paid program without agency support. This role would suit someone comfortable in a fast-paced environment, able to pivot and change tactics based on data and changing circumstances.

Reporting to our Director of Individual Giving, you’ll manage all paid acquisition for Individual Giving across Meta, Google, YouTube, and TikTok, and also work closely with the VP of Marketing to manage all upper-funnel media buys (e.g., newsletters, podcasts, etc.) for both the Individual Giving and Marketing teams. This role is responsible for executing our paid media program end to end, including negotiating and managing contracts, creating ads, capturing screenshots for documentation, publishing campaigns, and monitoring performance. You will also build our tracking and attribution systems and use that data to grow both one-time and monthly giving. To do so, we are looking for a strong individual contributor who is comfortable executing within the platforms without a big team or agency.

The Individual Giving team is responsible for generating revenue across donors with an annual gift below $50k. To do so, the Individual Giving team executes compelling public fundraising campaigns, drives creative donor-facing content, and tests new marketing initiatives aimed at expanding our donor base and raising awareness of direct cash transfers. You’ll join a small but high-performing team that runs several campaigns at once and works with a lot of independence. You’ll partner with Brand and Marketing colleagues each campaign cycle to ensure integrated marketing across all public-facing materials.

Level: Manager (we are willing to hire at Senior Manager for more experienced candidates)

Reports To: Director of Individual Giving
Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~1–2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits

What you’ll bring:

  • 3–5+ years in growth or performance marketing with a proven track record running paid media to a conversion or revenue target, in-house or agency, across Meta, Google, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Non-profit experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience managing a paid media budget of at least US$5M a year with a track record of strong performance measurement, with the discipline to trust your own data over platform recommendations and the judgment to know when to scale a channel, cut it, or admit it isn't working—pause and reset.
  • A genuine test-and-learn habit: you design multivariable testing across creative, audience, messaging, and landing pages, using these insights to scale the program.
  • Strong written communication, the ability to own creative direction of ads (from conception and drafting through launch), and experience with or a strong eye for graphic design (Figma, Canva). You’ll work with content creation teams for bigger projects, but initial ideation and direction should come from you.
  • Strong, succinct communication, and the ability to work productively with a Brand and Marketing team focused on brand awareness.
  • Alignment with GiveDirectly’s values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity.
  • Experience with tracking and attribution to ensure detailed reports are shared with senior management.

Bonus skills:

  • Experience with our tech stack (WordPress, Salesforce, PostHog, Google Analytics, Tableau, Zendesk, Ahrefs) or similar tools.
  • Experience with paid ads with a non-profit of a similar size or an agency supporting non-profits.

What you’ll do

Own paid media strategy and performance to execute growth and brand goals

  • Develop and execute the paid digital fundraising strategy that acquires new donors, grows revenue, and strengthens long-term supporter value across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, programmatic, and emerging platforms (approx. 50% of time).
  • Run top-of-funnel brand ads, from placement and contracting to creative direction and development, including podcasts, OOH, and connected TV (approx. 30% of time).
  • Manage and optimize paid investment daily, monitoring spend, pacing, cost per acquisition, and conversion, and reallocating budget as performance dictates.
  • Run a continuous test-and-learn program across audiences, creative messaging, channels, landing pages, and donation experiences, and turn results into decisions rather than reports.
  • Make key and strategic recommendations to the Director of Individual Giving and VP of Marketing on where budget spend should be allocated based on performance data.

Grow one-time and monthly giving through paid

  • Run acquisition and conversion campaigns for both one-time and monthly giving, testing paid tactics to grow the recurring program—the fastest-growing part of our portfolio.
  • Optimize the digital supporter journey so paid campaigns connect cleanly to landing pages, donation forms, email, and CRM, maximizing conversion and retention.
  • Analyze acquisition, conversion, revenue, and retention trends by segment to inform where the next dollar goes.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Stand up standardized paid-channel attribution and UTM tracking so acquisition spend is evaluable outside the ad platforms.
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards that connect campaign, website, and CRM data into a single view of what each channel returns.
  • Develop a forecasting model that projects cost per acquisition and revenue by channel, so budget increases are decisions rather than bets.
  • Report to senior management on budget and paid campaign performance on a bi-weekly basis.

This role might not be for you if

  • You are used to relying on an agency for recommendations or ad builds in the platforms themselves.
  • You do not have experience/familiarity with both upper-funnel and direct conversion paid advertising.
  • You are not comfortable managing projects from A–Z, including ideation, planning, launching, testing, iterating, and evaluating.

What success looks like in 12–18 months

  • A clear, measurable contribution to the 2027 goal of doubling new donor acquisition, with a 50–70% share of new monthly donors acquired through paid.
  • The Google Ad Grant is fully deployed against upper-funnel objectives, in compliance, and contributing measurable qualified traffic.
  • A documented acquisition model forecasts cost per acquisition and revenue by channel accurately enough to justify a materially larger paid budget.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third-party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no-negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here. Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in Kenya, the US, or the UK, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

United States

  • Base Salary: $99,940
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

  • Base Salary: £66,150
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $65,000
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454

raw.title: Mid Market Account Executive - Americas (West)
raw.description:
Why Join Sales at Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

You will help us win Mid-Market accounts in the Pacific and Central time zones by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won. In this role, you'll primarily focus on new logo acquisition, while also covering a smaller number of existing business accounts for expansion and upsell. Our emphasis is on your raw ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement. We’re a documentation first, async friendly team that values precision and autonomy. If you’re energized by seeking answers independently and collaborating through well structured resources, you’ll feel right at home here.

To ensure a smooth review process, please apply to only one territory (East or West) that best aligns with your location and time zone.

Role Requirements:

  • You have 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience and have closed many >$50,000 ACV opportunities

  • You have experience selling complex platform technologies in a sales-led GTM motion

  • You are a new business hunter and are confident in your abilities to self-source >30% of your own pipeline

You could be a great fit if:

  • ⚔️ You're adept at competitive selling in established markets and have won many rip-and-replace opportunities.

  • You're naturally curious about business problems and take pride in positioning specific & creative solutions that solve those problems.

  • You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms.

  • ️ You skillfully guide prospects through the evaluation & buying process—engaging the right stakeholders to create consensus for a strategic technology decision.

  • You love becoming a product and industry expert. You're adept at delivering a quick demo to showcase how your solution meets a unique need.

  • ⚡️ Your peers describe you as action-oriented and persistent. You're always on the leaderboard for outbound effort and pipeline created.

  • ⏱️ You leverage tools to maximize the impact of your prospecting and selling time. You believe in research and personalization to spark a conversation.

  • ⚙️ You are at home managing a pipeline of a dozen or more active opportunities concurrently. You take pride in internal operations, including real-time CRM updates.

Bonus:

  • You have sold to Talent or HR personas

  • ☎️ Prior BDR experience

Reasons not to apply:

  • You aren't excited about a new business focused role that includes pipeline generation work

  • You are uncomfortable delivering your own product demos, preferring to defer to an SE

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with 100% of all premiums covered by us, Flexible Spending Accounts and 401K match. We also offer up to 12 weeks of fully paid family/parental leave for all caregivers.

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

raw.title: Account Executive II, Mid-Market
raw.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. You are Outcome-Obsessed about revenue, forecast accuracy, and customer value.   • Stay current on competitor offerings and identify their strengths and vulnerabilities.

raw.title: Advertising Campaign Strategist
raw.description:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.

About the Role:

As an Advertising Campaign Strategist (ACS) at Demandbase, you'll play a critical role in helping our customers realize the full value of their investment in our advertising solutions. You’ll act as a strategic advisor and media expert—ensuring campaign success, driving full media utilization, and delivering actionable insights that demonstrate measurable business value.

The ACS is a hybrid of campaign manager, data analyst, and customer success partner. You’ll work cross-functionally with our Ad Ops, Product, and GTM teams to execute high-impact advertising campaigns while helping Demandbase achieve its internal revenue goals.

This role is positioned for growth into a Senior or Lead position.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Manage a book of ~20 customer accounts (volume may vary by segment)

  • Drive full utilization of booked media budgets through strategic execution and performance storytelling

  • Build and manage customer audience journeys and campaign briefs

  • Deliver compelling, insight-driven reports that support renewals and expansion

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners (CSMs, Ad Ops, Sales) to align campaign strategy and timelines

  • Surface optimization opportunities and serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning

  • Contribute to special projects, tiger teams, and the evolution of internal tools, templates, and processes

  • Support campaign launches and ensure impressions are served to drive accurate billing

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in digital advertising, ideally with a B2B focus

  • Experience in a customer-facing account management role, supporting mid-market and/or enterprise clients

  • Proven ability to translate campaign metrics into clear, actionable insights that demonstrate business impact

  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate success against performance targets

  • Strong technical proficiency with tools like Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • Experience buying and/or planning digital advertising campaigns is a plus

Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and financial security. Our employees enjoy up to 100% paid premiums for Medical and Vision coverage, ensuring access to top-tier care for you and your loved ones. In addition, we provide a range of mental wellness resources, including access to Modern Health, to help support your emotional well-being. We believe in a healthy work-life harmony, which is why we offer a flexible PTO policy, 15 paid holidays in 2026—including a three-day break around July 4th and a full week off for Thanksgiving—and No Internal Meetings Fridays to give you uninterrupted time to focus on what matters most. For your financial future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and other valuable benefits to ensure your financial peace of mind.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

raw.title: Oncology Specialist - Northwest TX / DFW
raw.description:
About Ataraxis AI

Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients.

Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research.

Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide.

At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine.

Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity).

We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Aggressively drive sales growth and market penetration of Ataraxis oncology products through direct sales to individual oncologists within your designated territory.

  • Prospecting new business and maintaining relationships.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of demonstrated high-performance sales experience in oncology, especially in breast cancer.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas and demonstrated achievement through awards or recognition (e.g., President's Club, Rookie of the Year).

  • Passionate about AI and innovation in healthcare, driven to learn and effectively communicate AI-based diagnostic solutions.

  • Autonomous, capable of excelling independently in a hyper-growth start-up environment.

  • Ability to thrive in a highly competitive environment; demonstrates resilience, urgency, and focus on closing deals.

raw.title: VP of Revenue Marketing
raw.description:
About the team

Revenue Marketing owns the global engine responsible for creating and accelerating pipeline at Veriff. The team brings together Account-Based Marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, web and SEO/AEO, field and events, and customer marketing.

We work closely with Sales and Revenue Operations to decide where to focus, how to engage priority accounts and buying groups, and how Marketing investment translates into measurable pipeline, revenue and ROI. The function also partners closely with Product Marketing, Account Management and other teams to create a coordinated go-to-market motion.

The opportunity

We’re looking for a VP of Revenue Marketing to lead the strategy and execution of Veriff’s global revenue marketing engine, with clear accountability for pipeline creation, acceleration and marketing ROI.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who knows how to build an integrated B2B marketing engine, brings deep expertise in ABM, and can balance strategy with true hands-on execution. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the strategy, team and operating model rather than inherit a fixed playbook.

What you'll achieve in your first 3 months

  • Diagnose the current revenue marketing engine across funnel performance, channel mix, budget, attribution and team structure, and share clear findings with Sales and RevOps.
  • Agree target accounts and ABM tiers across 1:1, 1:few and scaled programmes with Sales, alongside shared pipeline definitions and KPIs with RevOps.
  • Establish clear team priorities, KPIs and an operating rhythm, while delivering early wins such as an initial ABM pilot or improvements to website conversion.

What you'll achieve by 6 months

  • Have integrated ABM and demand-generation programmes running across priority accounts, with measurable engagement and progression.
  • Deliver measurable growth in marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline against agreed targets, with investment shifted toward the channels proven to have the greatest impact.
  • Establish trusted reporting and attribution with RevOps, alongside a sequenced 12-month revenue marketing plan and clear team structure.

What you'll bring — essential

  • Senior B2B marketing leadership experience, ideally with 10+ years in enterprise SaaS or technology and experience leading across multiple marketing disciplines.
  • Deep ABM expertise, including account selection, segmentation, intent signals, personalisation, multi-channel orchestration, Sales alignment and account-level measurement across 1:1, 1:few and scaled programmes.
  • A strong track record of building demand-generation programmes that create measurable pipeline and revenue, with the ability to optimise channel mix based on commercial impact rather than lead or MQL volume.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills, with fluency in funnel metrics, pipeline, attribution, conversion and marketing ROI, including experience owning and allocating budget.
  • Proven ability to operate as a true go-to-market partner to Sales and Revenue Operations, agreeing shared targets and priorities and working through disagreements constructively.
  • A builder mentality: able to set strategy and prioritise ruthlessly while staying close enough to the work to personally drive execution when needed.

Nice to have

  • Experience in identity, security, fintech or a related industry.
  • Hands-on experience with web strategy, SEO and emerging AEO / AI-driven discovery.
  • Experience building field and event programmes around target accounts, including executive dinners and roundtables.
  • Experience with customer marketing, lifecycle and advocacy programmes that have contributed to customer expansion.
  • Experience working in a global, multi-region go-to-market organisation.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...

  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives, and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Please take the time to read our Recruitment Privacy Notice, which explains how we collect and process your data for recruitment-related activities in accordance with applicable laws. Please read the information carefully. By submitting the application with the required information, you acknowledge that Veriff processes the information for recruitment purposes. Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process, we may request that you undergo identity verification. For more information, please see Recruitment Privacy Notice. #SPBTAL #LI-Remote

  • Agree target accounts and ABM tiers across 1:1, 1:few and scaled programmes with Sales, alongside shared pipeline definitions and KPIs with RevOps.
  • Establish clear team priorities, KPIs and an operating rhythm, while delivering early wins such as an initial ABM pilot or improvements to website conversion.

What you'll achieve by 6 months

  • Have integrated ABM and demand-generation programmes running across priority accounts, with measurable engagement and progression.
  • Deliver measurable growth in marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline against agreed targets, with investment shifted toward the channels proven to have the greatest impact.
  • Establish trusted reporting and attribution with RevOps, alongside a sequenced 12-month revenue marketing plan and clear team structure.

What you'll bring — essential

  • Senior B2B marketing leadership experience, ideally with 10+ years in enterprise SaaS or technology and experience leading across multiple marketing disciplines.
  • Deep ABM expertise, including account selection, segmentation, intent signals, personalisation, multi-channel orchestration, Sales alignment and account-level measurement across 1:1, 1:few and scaled programmes.
  • A strong track record of building demand-generation programmes that create measurable pipeline and revenue, with the ability to optimise channel mix based on commercial impact rather than lead or MQL volume.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills, with fluency in funnel metrics, pipeline, attribution, conversion and marketing ROI, including experience owning and allocating budget.
  • Proven ability to operate as a true go-to-market partner to Sales and Revenue Operations, agreeing shared targets and priorities and working through disagreements constructively.
  • A builder mentality: able to set strategy and prioritise ruthlessly while staying close enough to the work to personally drive execution when needed.

Nice to have

  • Experience in identity, security, fintech or a related industry.
  • Hands-on experience with web strategy, SEO and emerging AEO / AI-driven discovery.
  • Experience building field and event programmes around target accounts, including executive dinners and roundtables.
  • Experience with customer marketing, lifecycle and advocacy programmes that have contributed to customer expansion.
  • Experience working in a global, multi-region go-to-market organisation.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...

  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives, and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Please take the time to read our Recruitment Privacy Notice, which explains how we collect and process your data for recruitment-related activities in accordance with applicable laws. Please read the information carefully. By submitting the application with the required information, you acknowledge that Veriff processes the information for recruitment purposes. Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process, we may request that you undergo identity verification. For more information, please see Recruitment Privacy Notice. #SPBTAL #LI-Remote

raw.title: Vice President, Partnership Sales
raw.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Vice President, Partnership Sales

Remote Location: United States - Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC

Position Summary

HackerOne is seeking a Vice President, Partnership Sales to build and scale our partnership sales strategy and accelerate partner-led revenue growth. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will lead a team of seven Channel Account Managers and shape how HackerOne identifies, develops, and grows high-impact partnerships across strategic resellers, technology alliances, and cloud marketplaces.

You will establish the strategy, operating model, and executive relationships needed to make partnerships an increasingly productive and scalable growth channel for HackerOne. This is an opportunity to shape a critical revenue function while partnering across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Legal, Customer Success, and Product to strengthen HackerOne’s market presence and create durable growth.

What You Will Do

Success in the Vice President, Partnership Sales role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.

  • Own the Outcome for HackerOne’s partnership sales strategy and performance, establishing clear revenue goals, operating rhythms, accountability, and execution plans that increase partner-sourced and partner-influenced growth.

  • Multiply Your Impact by leading, coaching, and developing a high-performing team of seven Channel Account Managers across multiple levels and areas of focus. Build the leadership, capabilities, systems, and operating model required for the partnership sales function to scale beyond individual effort.

  • Apply First Principles Problem Solving to assess HackerOne’s existing partner landscape and determine where and how partnerships can create the greatest business value. Challenge legacy assumptions, simplify the partner model where needed, and concentrate resources on the partnerships and motions with the strongest potential for durable growth.

  • Advance AI Native by redesigning how the partnership sales team works, making AI the default operating layer and not a tool bolted onto existing workflows. Partner identification, prioritization, enablement, and execution should run through AI-native systems where human judgment is the steering input, not the manual labor. Forecasting is continuous and model-driven, not spreadsheet-and-gut. Enablement is generated and personalized, not templated and static. The team's scalable ways of working emerge from AI-native defaults: agents handle the repeatable, humans handle the relational, and every workflow is designed for that split from day one.

  • Use Data-Driven Decision Making to define the metrics that matter for partnership performance, evaluate partner productivity and pipeline contribution, inform investments and resource allocation, and continuously improve the effectiveness of the partnership sales strategy.

  • Demonstrate Change Agility by evolving partnership strategy and execution as HackerOne’s business, customers, technology ecosystem, and markets change. Provide clarity through ambiguity and ensure the team can adapt priorities while maintaining momentum against revenue objectives.

  • Build and deepen executive-level relationships with strategic resellers, technology partners, and cloud marketplaces, including the AWS ecosystem, creating joint strategies that strengthen HackerOne’s market position and generate measurable commercial impact.

  • Partner across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Legal, Customer Success, and Product to align partnership priorities with company strategy, remove barriers to execution, develop effective partner programs and enablement, and create a cohesive partner experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven sales leadership experience within information security, cybersecurity, or a closely related market, with demonstrated accountability for meaningful revenue outcomes.

  • Demonstrated experience building, establishing, or scaling channel and partnership sales programs, including leading teams responsible for reseller, channel, technology alliance, or cloud marketplace relationships.

  • Demonstrated success developing, negotiating, launching, and growing high-value strategic partnerships that generate measurable pipeline and revenue contribution.

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing sales or channel teams while establishing the strategy, performance metrics, operating cadence, and accountability required to scale results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and scaling partnerships within the AWS ecosystem or other major cloud marketplaces.

  • Experience operating in a growth environment generating $30M+ in new ARR.

  • Experience helping scale a company through significant stages of growth, including preparation for or progression toward an IPO.

  • Experience building a partnership function across multiple partner types, markets, or customer segments.

Compensation Bands:
Tier Guide

Tier A: $252-280k base salary plus commission (60/40 split)

Tier B: $226-277k base salary plus commission (60/40 split)

Tier C: $216-264k base salary plus commission (60/40 split)

#LI-Remote

#LI-KM1

Job Benefits:

  • Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance*

  • Equity stock options

  • Retirement plans

  • Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO

  • Paid maternity and parental leave

  • Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

  • Employee Assistance Program

*Eligibility may differ by country

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

For US based roles only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, all qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position.

raw.title: Data Validation Analyst
raw.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About the Role:

  • YipitData’s Corporate team collaborates directly with organizations like Traeger, FanDuel, Uber, and Harbor Freight to help them make sense of the vast amounts of external data available. We source, clean, organize, and contextualize data to support our clients in answering their key business questions. We are expanding our GTM Data Validation team within the Corporate practice by welcoming a Data Validation Analyst (Junior Sales Engineer) to support our new logo sales team through technical expertise and solutioning.
  • This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with 1-4 years of experience who wants to enhance their data analysis and client-facing skills, gain exposure to executives, have a meaningful impact on driving revenue growth by working closely with our sales team and get in on the ground floor of a growing team at YipitData. Our Solutions Engineering team collaborates closely with Sales and Data Product teams to demonstrate the accuracy and reliability of our data, create solutions for our partners, and set expectations to maximize client success and long term health.
  • You could be a good fit if you are comfortable working squarely at the intersection of revenue and data, troubleshooting with urgency and curiosity, and working in a highly customer focused role.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarter is located), one of our office hubs (Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, or Seattle), or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Solutions Engineering Analyst You Will:

  • Support our Sales and Account Executive teams through technical expertise, product mastery, and in-depth data analysis work to help prospective partners gain trust in our data, methodologies, and product outputs.
  • Work to understand customer goals and needs and scope appropriate solutions for them, balancing customer demand, budgets, and available data assets and coverage.
  • Troubleshoot data quality issues to overcome skepticism and guide improvements to data coverage and methodology.
  • Work cross-functipnally to help guide the onboarding journey and early customer success in collaboration with our data, insights, client strategy, and account executive teams.
  • Enable commercial partners through continuous refinement of available GTM assets and processes to accelerate deal cycles and power our growing business.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 1-4 years of experience in Sales Engineering, Client-Facing Data Analysis, Customer Success in a Technical Environment, or Sales/Account Management.
  • You are committed to long term account health, eager to understand customers and their needs and craft the solutions that power years long partnerships.
  • You are eager to be in a highly customer facing role.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $125K. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. We also have office hubs in Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, and Seattle. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Job Applicant Privacy Notice

raw.title: Business Development Associate
raw.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for Brands and Retailers. We analyze billions of alternative data points daily to provide accurate, detailed insights on retail, ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments, brands, and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data upon which many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend.

For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc's Best Workplaces. We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.

About The Role:

We are hiring a Business Development Associate to help our Corporate Sales team engage new clients. Our newest Business Development Associate will identify prospective opportunities and utilize a number of communication methods to begin a sales engagement, as well as qualify inbound sales leads/opportunities and follow up with marketing-qualified opportunities.

The Business Development Associate career progression is a path toward being a Sales Associate, and then a Sales Executive focused on bringing on and engaging new business.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States, but we strongly prefer this person to be in commutable distance to NYC for initial training. Depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. Please note that we pay NYC-based salaries for US roles regardless of where employees choose to work.

In this role, you’ll gain experience in:

  • Developing creative outbound sales skills by leveraging various communication methods, including cold calling, cold emailing, direct mail, and more.

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, a wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment of ownership, respect, and trust.

raw.title: Account Manager - SMB Sales
raw.description:
At WorkWave, we build innovative software and fintech solutions for the people who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful, from pest control to lawn care, commercial cleaning to security services. With over 8,000 customers around the globe, our platform helps these hardworking service professionals run and grow their businesses from end to end: from customer acquisition to scheduling, billing, payments, and beyond.

Our vision is simple but powerful: empower the world’s mobile service workers to build a brighter future. And we back that up with decades of experience, a passionate team, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers thrive.

WorkWave is looking for a driven Account Manager who possesses strong consultative and presentation skills. You will be responsible for learning how to navigate a Field Service software solution, provide online demonstrations, and consistently achieve a monthly quota.

Why Join Now:

We’re at an exciting moment in our growth journey. With the launch of Wavelytics, our new AI-powered analytics suite, and continued momentum in integrated payments, we’re unlocking new ways to deliver value to our customers, and new opportunities for our team. WorkWave operates in a field service management market that’s accelerating due to global trends in automation, sustainability, and digital transformation. Joining now means getting in early as we scale to meet massive demand and lead the future of service software.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead strategic Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align customer goals with product capabilities and drive long-term success
  • Educate and consult customers on how our solutions directly impact business performance, efficiency, and growth
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and tailored solution recommendations, effectively guiding prospects through the sales cycle to close new business
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly recurring revenue targets through strong pipeline management and value-driven selling
  • Generate new business opportunities through proactive outreach efforts including cold calling, personalized email campaigns, lead sourcing, and networking
  • Build and manage a robust sales pipeline and maintain accurate forecasting and deal tracking within Salesforce CRM

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 2+ years of proven success as a sales representative
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to act independently, multi-task, and handle prospective clients and issues simultaneously
  • Experience driving a sales pipeline
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience selling within the field service or T&L industries is a plus
  • This is an inside sales role

Compensation

In our dedication to salary transparency, we provide a compensation range for sales roles, which is $65,000 plus uncapped commission. The final offer will be dependent on various factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and the organization's budget. Our Talent Acquisition team will provide more information about the compensation package for this position during the interview process.

WorkWave supports salary transparency, however please note that salary estimates provided by websites (LinkedIn, Glassdoor, etc.) and not by WorkWave may not accurately reflect the actual salary range for the position.

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers

• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses

• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust

• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges

• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

• We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.

• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming.

• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.

• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including health and dental and 401k with company match

AND BEYOND...

• Find your perfect work/life balance with our Flexible Time Off policy or generous PTO plan (role dependent) and paid holidays

• Up to 4 weeks paid bonding leave

• Tuition reimbursement

• Robust Employee Assistance Program through TotalCare offering free counseling 24/7/365, plus financial counseling, legal guidance, adoption assistance services and much more!

• 24/7 access to virtual medical care with Teladoc

• Quarterly awards based on peer nominations

• Regional discounts and perks

• Opportunities to participate in charitable events and give back to the community

GROW WITH US:

• We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth

• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!

• Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year

JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM!

• 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz!

• WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine

• Recently named one of The Software Report's 3rd annual list of the Top 100 Software Companies of 2022 (worldwide!)

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status: Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At WorkWave, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you feel like you could make a great impact in this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

raw.title: Account Executive
raw.description:
Appen's Go to Market team sits at the center of the company's growth strategy, partnering with the world's most ambitious AI programs to deliver the data that makes models work. This role is responsible for acquiring net-new strategic logos and expanding high-value accounts across Big Tech, AI Labs, and Enterprise AI adopters. It's a high-visibility commercial role operating across Global and Americas markets.

Your Impact

You'll own end-to-end enterprise sales cycles, from discovery and qualification through commercial negotiation and contract execution, working from well-developed territory and account plans.

You'll stay multi-threaded across buying, technical, and operational stakeholders, positioning Appen's portfolio as the partner of choice by mapping capabilities directly to each client's AI program priorities. Expect to craft compelling business cases and proposals, and to run regular Executive Business Reviews to keep clients aligned on strategic goals and surface new partnership opportunities.

Pipeline comes from outbound account-based strategies run in partnership with Marketing, backed by strong CRM discipline and accurate, timely forecasts. You'll also orchestrate internal teams across Client Partners, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to shape the solution and pricing behind each bid.

Success in this role looks like year-on-year growth in the accounts you own, and enough standing inside them to influence how those programs are scoped and resourced.

What You Bring

  • A proven track record of closing complex enterprise deals gained selling directly into frontier AI labs in the AI training data, RLHF, or model evaluation space.
  • Exceptional communication skills with enough technical credibility to influence engineering and research stakeholders, and C-suite.
  • The ability to lead complex RFP responses and negotiate MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, and other enterprise agreements.
  • A creative approach to problem solving, and the competitive drive to keep moving opportunities forward.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models. You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

Compensation

Additional Information

Base Salary: $150,000 – $200,000 USD. This range reflects the good faith estimate of starting base pay for a new hire in this role as of the posting date.

On-Target Earnings (OTE): Structured as a 50/50 split between base and commission.

raw.title: Partner Development Manager
raw.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio is looking for a Partner Development Manager to build and grow a portfolio of strategic reseller relationships — Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), telematics providers, and VARs — across the full partner lifecycle. This is a true hunter-farmer role: you'll be equally accountable for sourcing, qualifying, and signing new reseller partners and for managing and growing the partners already in your book. You're comfortable running a cold or warm partner pipeline from first conversation to signed agreement, and just as comfortable sitting across from an existing partner asking "where's our next dollar of growth together."

You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Legal to build the partner pipeline, close new agreements, enable partners post-signature, and turn signed relationships into ramped, revenue-generating accounts.

What You'll Do

New Partner Development

  • Identify, prospect, and qualify new reseller partner candidates across FMC, Telematics, and VAR segments, building and managing your own outbound pipeline.
  • Own the full sales cycle for new partner agreements — discovery, pitch, commercial negotiation, legal/redline coordination — through signature.
  • Score and prioritize prospective partners against Fleetio's qualification criteria (market fit, geographic fit, program maturity, pipeline potential) to focus effort on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Build relationships with executive sponsors at prospective partner organizations to secure buy-in and accelerate path-to-close.
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date view of the partner pipeline (stage, blockers, next actions, target ETA) in Salesforce/partner tracking tools.

Existing Partner Growth

  • Own a book of signed reseller partners end-to-end — from onboarding and enablement through renewal and expansion.
  • Build and maintain a shared definition of "growth" with each partner: agreed targets for assets under management, ARR, and pipeline, tracked consistently and revisited regularly.
  • Proactively identify incremental revenue opportunities within existing partner accounts — new segments, new use cases, underpenetrated regions, or expanded product attach.
  • Drive partner performance against joint business plans, holding partners (and internal stakeholders) accountable to commitments and timelines.
  • Support QBRs, joint marketing initiatives, and co-selling motions with key partners.

Across Both

  • Partner closely with internal Sales teams to ensure partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities are tracked, supported, and closed efficiently.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each partner's business model, competitive position, and channel economics in order to tailor Fleetio's value proposition and identify white space.
  • Represent the voice of the partner internally — surfacing blockers, feedback, and market intelligence to Product, Marketing, and Partnerships leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, or a strategic account management role — ideally in B2B SaaS, fleet, telematics, or a related vertical.
  • Demonstrated success in both new business development (sourcing and closing new partner/channel agreements) and account growth (expanding revenue within an existing partner book) — this is not a role for a pure hunter or a pure farmer.
  • A strong sales and commercial orientation: you think in terms of pipeline, ARR, attach rate, and growth levers, whether the partner is brand-new or five years in.
  • Proven track record of growing revenue through third-party partners/resellers, with concrete examples from both new-logo signing and existing-account expansion.
  • Comfort managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals — including commercial negotiation and coordinating through legal/contracting cycles.
  • Strong executive presence; experience building and maintaining relationships with senior partner stakeholders and sponsors, pre- and post-signature.
  • Highly organized and self-directed — able to manage a diverse portfolio of partners at very different stages (prospecting, qualification, contracting, ramping, mature) simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting performance and plans to both partners and internal leadership.
  • Experience with CRM/partner tracking tools (Salesforce or similar) for pipeline and account management.
  • Familiarity with the fleet management, telematics, or FMC/VAR reseller landscape is a strong plus.
  • Bias toward action and ownership — you don't wait to be told where the next dollar of growth is, whether that's a brand-new partner or an existing one; you go find it.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

metadata.jobDescription:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio is looking for a Partner Development Manager to build and grow a portfolio of strategic reseller relationships — Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), telematics providers, and VARs — across the full partner lifecycle. This is a true hunter-farmer role: you'll be equally accountable for sourcing, qualifying, and signing new reseller partners and for managing and growing the partners already in your book. You're comfortable running a cold or warm partner pipeline from first conversation to signed agreement, and just as comfortable sitting across from an existing partner asking "where's our next dollar of growth together."

You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Legal to build the partner pipeline, close new agreements, enable partners post-signature, and turn signed relationships into ramped, revenue-generating accounts.

What You'll Do

New Partner Development

  • Identify, prospect, and qualify new reseller partner candidates across FMC, Telematics, and VAR segments, building and managing your own outbound pipeline.
  • Own the full sales cycle for new partner agreements — discovery, pitch, commercial negotiation, legal/redline coordination — through signature.
  • Score and prioritize prospective partners against Fleetio's qualification criteria (market fit, geographic fit, program maturity, pipeline potential) to focus effort on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Build relationships with executive sponsors at prospective partner organizations to secure buy-in and accelerate path-to-close.
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date view of the partner pipeline (stage, blockers, next actions, target ETA) in Salesforce/partner tracking tools.

Existing Partner Growth

  • Own a book of signed reseller partners end-to-end — from onboarding and enablement through renewal and expansion.
  • Build and maintain a shared definition of "growth" with each partner: agreed targets for assets under management, ARR, and pipeline, tracked consistently and revisited regularly.
  • Proactively identify incremental revenue opportunities within existing partner accounts — new segments, new use cases, underpenetrated regions, or expanded product attach.
  • Drive partner performance against joint business plans, holding partners (and internal stakeholders) accountable to commitments and timelines.
  • Support QBRs, joint marketing initiatives, and co-selling motions with key partners.

Across Both

  • Partner closely with internal Sales teams to ensure partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities are tracked, supported, and closed efficiently.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each partner's business model, competitive position, and channel economics in order to tailor Fleetio's value proposition and identify white space.
  • Represent the voice of the partner internally — surfacing blockers, feedback, and market intelligence to Product, Marketing, and Partnerships leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, or a strategic account management role — ideally in B2B SaaS, fleet, telematics, or a related vertical.
  • Demonstrated success in both new business development (sourcing and closing new partner/channel agreements) and account growth (expanding revenue within an existing partner book) — this is not a role for a pure hunter or a pure farmer.
  • A strong sales and commercial orientation: you think in terms of pipeline, ARR, attach rate, and growth levers, whether the partner is brand-new or five years in.
  • Proven track record of growing revenue through third-party partners/resellers, with concrete examples from both new-logo signing and existing-account expansion.
  • Comfort managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals — including commercial negotiation and coordinating through legal/contracting cycles.
  • Strong executive presence; experience building and maintaining relationships with senior partner stakeholders and sponsors, pre- and post-signature.
  • Highly organized and self-directed — able to manage a diverse portfolio of partners at very different stages (prospecting, qualification, contracting, ramping, mature) simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting performance and plans to both partners and internal leadership.
  • Experience with CRM/partner tracking tools (Salesforce or similar) for pipeline and account management.
  • Familiarity with the fleet management, telematics, or FMC/VAR reseller landscape is a strong plus.
  • Bias toward action and ownership — you don't wait to be told where the next dollar of growth is, whether that's a brand-new partner or an existing one; you go find it.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote
